card.name: Just before brand-name oncology drug names
card.fires_on: Small words right before or inside a brand-name cancer drug name, such as 'taking' before VITRAKVI or 'with' after 'in combination'. Also the space before a section or grade number.

modes.label: Linking word near drug name
modes.description: A verb or 'with' that comes right before a capitalized kinase-inhibitor brand name or partner drug.
modes.example: in patients<< taking>> VITRAKVI. In patients

modes.label: Combination phrase
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'in combination' naming a partner drug.
modes.example: of patients receiving BRAFTOVI in combination<< with>> cetuximab and mFOL

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space just before a grade, table or section number in a label cross-reference.

card.plain: It fires on little words next to cancer drug brand names, mostly 'with' in combination phrases.
